'''''Teucrium scordium''''', known commonly as '''water germander''',<ref>{{cite web|url=https://pfaf.org/user/Plant.aspx?LatinName=Teucrium+scordium |title=Plants For A Future: Teucrium scordium - L.|accessdate=2025-05-09}}</ref> is a species of [[flowering plant]] belonging to the family [[Lamiaceae]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web |title=Teucrium scordium L. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:460713-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=2 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

==Distribution==
[[File:Teucrium scordium - Distribuzione.png|thumb|Italian distribution]]
Its native range is Europe to China.<ref name="POWO" />
